The mutable allowed values can be updated for both user defined and System defined attributes. The immutable allowed values cannot be updated or deleted. The updated list of allowed values cannot be empty. If an allowed value that is already used by some resource's attribute is deleted, then the association between the resource and the attribute value will also be deleted. * cardinality The cardinality can be updated for user defined attributes only. Cardinality can only be increased during an update. The update_mask should be used to specify the fields being updated.
